title: GARSE MC
description: Official modpack for the GARSE Minecraft server. Fabric 1.20.1 with Create, Farmer's Delight, BlueMap, and more.
body:
# GARSE MC

Official modpack for the GARSE community server.

## Included Mods

- **Create** - Mechanical contraptions and automation
- **Farmer's Delight** - Cooking and farming expansion
- **BlueMap** - Live 3D web map
- **Steam 'n' Rails** - Extended train system
- **WorldEdit** - Building tools
- **Flan** - Land claiming
- **Lithium/FerriteCore** - Performance optimization
- And 22 more!

## Server Info

- **IP:** 64.20.48.82:25565
- **Version:** Fabric 1.20.1
- **Discord:** [discord.gg/garse](https://discord.gg/garse)

## Installation

1. Download the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app) or use Prism Launcher
2. Search for **GARSE MC** or click Install
3. Connect to 64.20.48.82:25565

That's it. See you in-game.
